tasks.description: Create a new organization by collecting organization name, subdomain/slug, and first administrator account details. Completing onboarding provisions an empty, isolated tenant workspace and signs the first admin into it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new organization, when onboarding is completed, then a new tenant workspace is provisioned.
Given a new organization, when onboarding is completed, then the first admin is signed into the tenant workspace.

tasks.description: Create default roles (at minimum Admin and Member) for each tenant. These roles will be used to assign permissions to users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new tenant, when default roles are created, then Admin and Member roles exist.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to define custom roles by selecting from available permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a custom role is created, then the role is added to the list of available roles.
Given a tenant admin, when a custom role is created, then the role's permissions are correctly assigned.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to invite new users by email and assign one or more roles to the invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a user is invited, then the invitee receives an email with a link to accept.
Given a tenant admin, when a user is invited, then the invitee is assigned the correct roles.

tasks.description: Record an immutable audit log of significant actions within a tenant, including user invited, user removed, role changed, permission changed, billing plan changed, API key created or revoked, and settings changed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a significant action, when the action is performed, then an audit log entry is created.
Given an audit log entry, when the entry is viewed, then the correct information is displayed.

tasks.description: Display per-tenant usage metrics such as active users, API request volume, and storage consumed, displayed over a selectable time range.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when usage metrics are viewed, then the correct metrics are displayed.
Given a tenant, when usage metrics are viewed, then the metrics are displayed over the correct time range.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to view the current plan, see current usage against plan limits, and upgrade or downgrade the plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when the current plan is viewed, then the correct plan information is displayed.
Given a tenant admin, when the plan is upgraded or downgraded, then the correct changes are applied.

tasks.description: Allow tenants to configure SAML-based single sign-on so their users authenticate through the tenant's own identity provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when SSO is configured, then users can authenticate through the tenant's identity provider.
Given a tenant, when SSO is configured, then the correct authentication flow is used.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to create named API keys scoped to their tenant, view the list of active keys, and revoke a key.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an API key is created, then the key is added to the list of active keys.
Given a tenant admin, when an API key is revoked, then the key is removed from the list of active keys.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to toggle tenant-level feature flags to enable or disable optional product capabilities for their organization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a feature flag is toggled, then the correct feature is enabled or disabled.
Given a tenant admin, when a feature flag is viewed, then the correct flag state is displayed.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to request an export of their tenant's data. The export is generated asynchronously and, when ready, made available for download.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when data export is requested, then the export is generated asynchronously.
Given a tenant admin, when data export is ready, then the export is made available for download.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to configure tenant-wide options such as organization display name, tenant subdomain/slug, default role assigned to new members, and default timezone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when tenant-level settings are viewed, then the correct settings are displayed.
Given a tenant admin, when tenant-level settings are updated, then the correct changes are applied.

tasks.description: Ensure that no tenant can read or write another tenant's data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when data is accessed, then only the correct tenant's data is accessible.
Given a tenant, when data is written, then only the correct tenant's data is modified.

tasks.description: Ensure that all admin actions are permission-gated via RBAC.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin action, when the action is performed, then the correct permissions are checked.
Given an admin action, when the action is performed, then the action is only allowed if the correct permissions are present.

tasks.description: Record an immutable audit log of significant actions within a tenant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a significant action, when the action is performed, then an audit log entry is created.
Given an audit log entry, when the entry is viewed, then the correct information is displayed.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to revoke an invitation before it is accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an invitation is revoked, then the invitation is removed from the list of pending invitations.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to resend an invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an invitation is resent, then the invitation is sent to the invitee again.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to create named API keys scoped to their tenant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an API key is created, then the key is added to the list of active keys.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to revoke an API key.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an API key is revoked, then the key is removed from the list of active keys.

tasks.description: Notify tenant admins when an export is ready for download.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an export is ready, then a notification is sent to the admin.

tasks.description: Validate tenant-level settings to ensure they are correct and consistent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when tenant-level settings are updated, then the settings are validated to ensure correctness and consistency.
